x: George Long, after five months in Normandy, is back in the mountains of Scotland. David Bayley, one of our newer members, stationed in N. Ireland, ran second in a one mile race over there.
Dave Bayley has returned from Ireland and is now with the A.P.T.C. at Oswestry, Shropshire. Sergeant Bolton won a Battalion five miles' C.-C. race; he is with the East Surreys.
